name: Rietveld Schröderhuis (Rietveld Schröder House)
description: This small brick house on the edge of Utrecht, in the Netherlands, looks like a three-dimensional painting, with flat white and grey planes and slim beams in red, yellow and blue. Gerrit Rietveld built it in 1924 with his client Truus Schröder-Schräder, who wanted a home with almost no fixed walls. Upstairs, sliding partitions reshape the rooms, and the house is now a museum you can tour.
